# optimizelycmssaas_blueprint (Data Source)

Looks up an existing blueprint by key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmssaas_blueprint" "existing" {
  key = "<blueprint key>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the blueprint to look up.

### Read-Only

- `content_json` (String) JSON object with the blueprint data: {"properties": {"title": {"value": "..."}}} (every property value is wrapped as {value = ...}) and optionally binding and composition (use jsonencode). Fields the API adds as defaults are ignored when detecting drift.
- `content_type` (String) Content type the blueprint is for. Cannot be changed.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown when choosing a blueprint.
